text:
Lina: okay this is weird but hear me out 31f
Lina: can we start an "Anonymous Compliment Lantern"? leave a note, pin it to the paper lantern in the kitchen, brighten someone's day.
Omar: love that. very low friction kindness.
Bea: rules? do we require handwriting or can we do tiny Post-its?
Carlos: Post-its only. The lantern must look like a tiny constellation of compliments.
Eli: also: compliments must be specific. 'Nice work' is a crime. cite one thing.
jamie-design: I can make little star-shaped stickers that say 'verified compliment' so people can add flair.
Lina: star stickers = mandatory. also propose an optional small reward: one coffee voucher per week drawn from the lantern notes.
Omar: ooo raffle! anonymous pick on Fridays?
ops-bot: poll created: "How often should we draw a compliment for a coffee voucher?" 3 options: Weekly; Biweekly; Monthly. React with :one: :two: :three: to vote.
hr-bot: Reminder: please avoid identifiable health/medical details in public notes. Keep it kind and appropriate.
Bea: what about negative notes? like constructive feedback disguised as compliment?
Carlos: no negativity. This is a safe uplift zone. If you want feedback start a different thread.
Eli: implementation detail: I'll staple a tiny envelope to the lantern where people can drop notes if they want true anonymity.
jamie-design: sticker mockups incoming. gold stars or pastel?
Lina: gold. always gold.
Omar: eta for first draw? Friday 10am?
Bea: I'll bring cookies for the first reveal.
Lina: done. Lantern launching ceremony: gather at kitchen 9:55. tiny bell optional.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: 'Compliment Lantern Launch' Friday 09:55 in #random.
Carlos: documenting for lore: this thread officially starts the Lantern Era. future interns will read this and think we were very earnest.
Eli: earnest and caffeinated.
Lina: grateful already. thanks team. :sparkles:
